KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda

(kecuali teksi dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan enam roda (kecuali bas)

Kelas 3: Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih (kecuali bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesuatu kenderaan, gandar dan roda

mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah dikira sebagai sebahagian

daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu.".

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(KAJANG−SEREMBAN HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Kajang−Seremban Highway) (Amendment) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Kajang−Seremban Highway) Order 2010 [P.U. (A) 61/2010], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1) by deleting the words

"according to the concession years".

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The principal Order is amended by substituting the First Schedule the following

Schedule:

CLASSES OF VEHICLE

Class 1: Vehicle having two axles and three or four wheels (excluding taxi and

bus)

Class 2: Vehicle having two axles and six wheels (excluding bus)

Class 3: Vehicle having three axles or more (excluding bus)

Class 4: Taxi

Class 5: Bus

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".
